# GreenChainz — Copilot Instructions

Read this before writing any code. These instructions apply to every file in this repository.

---

## What This App Is

This is a **full-stack TypeScript monorepo** — a B2B marketplace for verified sustainable building materials.

- **Backend**: Express 5 server (`server/`) bundled with `esbuild` into `dist/index.js`
- **Frontend**: Vite + React 19 SPA (`client/`) built into `dist/public/`
- **API layer**: tRPC 11 (type-safe, no REST — all routes are tRPC procedures)
- **ORM**: Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL (`drizzle/schema.ts` → `drizzle-orm/pg-core`)
- **Package manager**: `pnpm` ONLY — never `npm` or `yarn`

The server and client are built separately but deployed as a single container image on **Azure Container Apps**.

---

## This Is an Azure-First Application

Every infrastructure service runs on Azure. Do not suggest AWS, GCP, Firebase, Supabase, Vercel, Railway, Render, or any non-Azure hosting.

| Service | Azure Product |
|---|---|
| App hosting | Azure Container Apps |
| Authentication | Azure Entra ID (Easy Auth sidecar) |
| Secrets | Azure Key Vault |
| Database | PostgreSQL on Azure |
| Storage | Azure Blob Storage |
| Search | Azure AI Search |
| Queues | Azure Storage Queue |
| Real-time | Azure Web PubSub |
| AI / LLM | Azure OpenAI |
| Maps | Azure Maps |
| OCR / Forms | Azure AI Form Recognizer |
| Config | Azure App Configuration |
| Monitoring | Sentry (integrated with Azure) |

## Auth — Critical Rules

- **Production auth is handled entirely by the Azure Easy Auth sidecar.** It intercepts all `/.auth/*` routes before the Express app sees them. Do not write any auth middleware that duplicates this.
- **Local dev only**: `registerDevAuthShim()` in `server/_core/index.ts` simulates Easy Auth. It is guarded by `NODE_ENV !== 'production'`.
- **User identity always comes from server-side Easy Auth headers** (`X-MS-CLIENT-PRINCIPAL-*`). Never trust `userId`, `orgId`, or `role` values from the request body, query string, or client-supplied JWT.
- **Never mix** `MANAGED_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID` (the managed identity for Key Vault access) with `CLIENT_ID` (the Entra ID app registration for user auth). They are different Azure resources.
- `OAUTH_SERVER_URL` and all Azure credentials go in `.env`, never `.env.local`.
- Azure Entra ID tenant: `ca4f78d4-c753-4893-9cd8-1b309922b4dc`
- Client App ID: `479e2a01-70ab-4df9-baa4-560d317c3423`

## Express + Vite Architecture

This is NOT a Next.js app. There is no SSR, no file-based routing, no server components.

```
client/          ← Vite React SPA
  src/
    components/
    pages/
    lib/
server/          ← Express 5 API server
  _core/
    index.ts     ← Entry point (esbuild bundles this)
  routes/        ← tRPC routers
drizzle/
  schema.ts      ← All DB table definitions
  migrations/    ← Auto-generated by drizzle-kit
```

**Build output:**
- `dist/public/` — Vite client build (served as static files by Express)
- `dist/index.js` — esbuild server bundle (what the container runs)

**Dev server**: `pnpm run dev` starts both Vite (HMR) and the Express server concurrently.

---

## pnpm — No Exceptions

```bash
# Always use pnpm
pnpm install
pnpm add <package>
pnpm run build
pnpm run dev

# Never use npm or yarn
```

If `node_modules` is corrupt:
```bash
rm -rf node_modules && pnpm install
```

Pinned version: `pnpm@10.28.2` via `corepack`.

---

## Drizzle Schema — Import Rule

Every column type used in `drizzle/schema.ts` must be explicitly imported from `drizzle-orm/pg-core`. Missing imports cause a `ReferenceError` crash at container startup.

```ts
import {
  pgTable, text, integer, smallint, boolean,
  timestamp, uuid, varchar, numeric, jsonb,
  index, uniqueIndex,
} from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
```

After schema changes: `pnpm run db:generate` then `pnpm run db:migrate`.

---

## Docker Build

```bash
# Normal rebuild
docker compose up --build

# Full rebuild after import/schema changes (no cache)
docker compose build --no-cache app && docker compose up
```

Both `vite build` (step 1) and `esbuild` (step 2) must succeed. Any TypeScript import error in `server/` will fail the esbuild step with exit code 1.
